title:
Utility for formatting arbitrary data into text. Extends capabilities of Template by addition of Java printf style
format and positional formatting arguments.

Syntax is based on https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/11/docs/api/java.base/java/util/Formatter.html with
following additions:

* `%v` - denotes "quoted value": i.e. if formatting argument is not null, boolean or number it will be quoted using
         single quote character `'`
* `%j` - denotes "single line json": i.e. if formatting argument will be converted to single line json and printed in
         a single line
* `%J` - denotes "pretty print json": i.e. if formatting argument will be converted to potentially  multi-line
         indented json text

E.g.:
```
StrFormat.make("e = %+10.4f").format(Math.E)                               // "e =    +2,7183"
StrFormat.make("Invalid values %v and %v").format("foo bar", 17)           // "Invalid values 'foo bar' and 17"
StrFormat.make("Invalid User.id=${id} name=${quote(name)}").format(user)   // "Invalid User.id=BA name='B A'"
```
name: StrFormat
